checks.description: The equipped agent names a catalog title character-for-character from cue-cards.json (which is char-for-char with cartridge.json). A pitch for 'Zooted Zone' must say 'Zooted Zone' — not a paraphrase, not a guess at a track name.
The Spotify URL attached to the named title is the exact spotify_url for that title in cue-cards.json. No swapped links, no shortened links, no links to other catalogs.

Every pitch carries the exact sync rights line verbatim: 'Label-direct licensing; happy to work through your clearance process.' plus the public contact hp@cumulativeweb.com. No paraphrase, no truncation, no added promises.
